text:
driftbot: DRIFT ALERT — gitops detected a partial apply in prod-east for cluster 'inference-prod-east'.

  Summary: terraform apply returned success for 2/3 resources; resource 'azure_node_pool.nodepool-gpu' showed provider error and was marked SKIPPED. Reconciler left live state inconsistent with desired.
  Link: https://git.example.com/runs/78234 (terraform exit 1)

mira: pinging @eng-infra — can someone take a look? this might affect nodepool autoscaler and GPU capacity for prod-east. :eyes:

alex: i executed a manual kubectl taint on one nodepool yesterday to isolate regulatory workloads (taint: regulatory=true:NoSchedule). i did NOT run terraform apply afterward because the provider was flaky.

sam: oof — manual taints outside gitops. that explains why autoscaler / node counts didn't match the commit in git. we need to avoid evicting pods.

nina: whats the current nodepool state? are pods being drained/evicted? any failed pods?

mira: running quick queries —
```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide --context prod-east
# shows 6 nodes, 2 tainted regulatory=true:NoSchedule, autoscaler target 4, current desired 6
```

mira: also ran gitopsctl reconcile --env prod-east --resource nodepool-gpu --dry-run, output:
```
RECONCILE: resource would be patched. plan includes: set node_taints[+regulatory=true], desired_count: 4 -> 6 (but provider skip on apply previously)
```

ops-bot: NOTE: autorepair is currently PAUSED for prod-east to avoid cascaded reboots (manual pause by @jeff at 11:02). see runbook: https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/nodepool-drift

jeff: i paused autorepair because we had a spot fallback event earlier this morning. if we unpause now, cluster autoscaler might try to delete nodes with the manual taint and evict pods.

alex: i can open an emergency PR that reconciles the taint into git and sets a temporary lifecycle hook so rollout doesn't delete nodes. will include a canary with 10m wait.

sam: 👍 do that. include a terraform apply with `-target=azure_node_pool.nodepool-gpu` after CI approves, and then monitor token-level latency. avoid full cluster reapply.

mira: agreed. plan: (1) alex creates PR with taint + lifecycle hook + increase min_nodes to 6; (2) run gitopsctl reconcile --env prod-east --resource nodepool-gpu --force after CI green; (3) keep autorepair paused for 30m post-apply; (4) monitor evictions and GPU utilization. i'll own monitoring and escalation.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #1245 by alex -> staging then prod-east canary. CI status: pending.

sam: also add an alert rule to catch "gitops:partial-apply" events and tag high-severity when nodepool counts differ from desired for >5m. we've had recurring flakey provider errors.

mira: noted. I'll add the alert after we close the PR. for now, alex pls post the PR link here when ready and tag ops-oncall.

alex: making the PR now, link shortly.
